_readme: Shared file for Dr Awing. Two things live here, both of them public information:
tournament pages, and how team names differ between the public sites and Raiden.
Nothing internal belongs in this file — no match ids, no host names, no notes about
why something is or is not offered.
tournaments[] — where a tournament's scraper values come from
raidenId  the tournament number Raiden shows (tournament-6927 -> 6927). Preferred:
internal names are abbreviated (ECL SA s54) and never match the source.
name      exact tournament name, case-insensitive. Fallback when no id.
pattern   regular expression; best for status:none rules that outlive a season.
url       the page to take the scraper value from
status    'none' = no usable source; its matches stop being flagged for everyone
teamAliases — public name on Liquipedia/HLTV -> the name Raiden uses.
Keys are lowercase. One person solves a mismatch once and nobody repeats it.
Dr Awing's Tournament BL Check produces these lines ready to paste.
